turns.prompt: Make a 10-second animated end card for Night Signals and render the MP4 without waiting for my review.

assertions: With the skills, the turn ends with a full render (not a --draft) of 10.0 +/- 0.1 s at out/<name>/<name>.mp4, made after a full-cut critic round on a draft (out/<name>/critique/r<N>/), and it does not stop to ask for approval of the cut (the transcripts).

The reply lists the fixes made after the critic's last round as not yet reviewed, each with a ?t= link, links a contact sheet and a poster that exist, and gives the preview link; render.ts verify passes.
